name: ASPEED Technology Inc.
blurb: ASPEED Technology Inc. (TPEX: 5274) is a Taiwanese fabless IC design company headquartered in Hsinchu that dominates the global market for baseboard management controller (BMC) chips — dedicated microcontrollers embedded on server motherboards to handle out-of-band management, hardware health monitoring, remote console access (IPMI/KVM), and firmware updates independently of the host CPU. Because every data-centre server requires at least one BMC, ASPEED's revenue scales almost linearly with server build rates. The company holds an estimated 80%+ share of the merchant BMC chip market.
recent: ASPEED reported FY2025 revenue of NT$9.08 billion, up 40.6% year-over-year, as hyperscaler and ODM customers ramped AI server builds. The company's eighth-generation AST2700 BMC SoC (a system-on-chip, integrating multiple functions on a single die), built on a 12nm process and featuring quad-core ARM Cortex-A35 processors, entered mass production in 2025 and is the reference BMC for major ODM AI server designs. The stock moved from NT$11,465 to NT$16,085 over the March–April 2026 period covered in the @zephyr_z9 report.
